title: Practice
description: Structured GTO training exercises with configurable type, category, and difficulty
notes: Default initial state: GTO Quiz selected (no Timer Duration section)
Timed Drill selection reveals Timer Duration section (30s/60s/120s)
Spaced Repetition shows progress stats: '0 spots tracked · 0 due for review'
Selection state tracked via CSS class (not aria-pressed) — use visibility of conditionally-rendered sections as state indicator
No JavaScript errors across all states

exercise_type_selector.label: Exercise Type
exercise_type_selector.pattern: one-of-many toggle (CSS class based, no aria-pressed)
assertions: Clicking a different exercise type hides the old type's specific sections and shows new ones
Default selection is GTO Quiz on first load

timer_duration.label: Timer Duration
timer_duration.description: Earn speed bonus: answer faster for up to +50 pts per spot
assertions: Timer Duration section is only visible when Exercise Type = Timed Drill
Timer buttons exist only when Timed Drill is selected

spaced_repetition_stats.label: Spaced Repetition
spaced_repetition_stats.content: 🧠 Spaced Repetition — {N} spots tracked · {N} due for review
assertions: Progress stats only visible when Exercise Type = Spaced Repetition
Stats show two numbers: spots tracked and due for review

start_button.label: Start Practice Session
start_button.navigates_to: practice session (new page/overlay — verify URL change)
assertions: Clicking Start navigates to the practice session view
Button is always visible when any exercise type is selected

transitions.effect: timer filter updated (only when Timed Drill)

selectors_guide.strategy: Use button text content to identify elements since no aria-label or aria-pressed attributes exist. CSS classes indicate selection state but are unstable — rely on conditional section visibility instead.
example_selectors: button that contains the text 'GTO Quiz'
button that contains the text 'Start Practice Session'
